name: Vendor and Supplier Contract
description: Risk checklist for vendor agreements, supplier contracts, and purchase orders.

categories.name: Pricing and payment
categories.description: Flag pricing that can be changed unilaterally, lack of price protection clauses, or payment terms that are significantly unfavorable.

categories.name: Delivery and performance
categories.description: Flag vague delivery timelines, no penalties for late delivery, or performance metrics that are undefined or unmeasurable.

categories.name: Warranty and defects
categories.description: Flag limited or no warranty on goods/services, short warranty periods, or warranty that excludes common defect types.

categories.name: Liability and indemnification
categories.description: Flag uncapped liability for the buyer, broad indemnification favoring the vendor, or limitation of liability that falls below the contract value.

categories.name: Termination and supply continuity
categories.description: Flag vendor ability to terminate without notice, no transition assistance, or minimum purchase commitments that survive termination.

categories.name: Data and compliance
categories.description: Flag vendor access to sensitive data without adequate protection, lack of compliance certifications, or no audit rights.
